# appsignal_app (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing app by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get app by ID
data "appsignal_app" "app" {
  id = "abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the app. Must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was created.
- `environment` (String) The environment of the app.
- `name` (String) The name of the app.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was updated.
